question: Under footnote *4, which calendar period(s) satisfy the requirement that the once-per-permit-term whole effluent toxicity test be performed 'during the first springtime after the permit effective date, during the irrigation season'?
semantic_arguments: Interpretation of 'first springtime' as a bounded calendar period
Interpretation of 'irrigation season' for the lower Animas Ditch
Whether the remainder of footnote *4 ('when irrigation return flows in the lower Animas Ditch likely discharge...') imposes mandatory timing prerequisites or serves as descriptive rationale
Intersection of the derived timing window with Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30)
notes: Footnote *4 governs when the once-per-term WET monitoring for Outfall 001 must occur. Different readings of its temporal and conditional language would change whether WET monitoring was required during FY2025 (Purpose B) and how to classify absent WET results for that period (Purpose C). WET limits are report-only, so Purpose A numeric limit applicability is not materially affected.
